<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a consumable product, able to restore a relatively moderate amount of health and energy. Similar to other bottles of juice, it is a by-product of a [[Grapes|fruit]] without the additional step of fermentation, though unlike other bottles of juice, this has various levels of quality, given that the fruit it's derived from also has varying qualities.
